Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 9

“This world is bound by action other than that performed for the sake of sacrifice. Perform action for that purpose, Kaunteya, free from attachment.”

The key distinction of the chapter is yajna. Action offered rather than owned does not bind. Krishna is not asking for less activity, only for a different relationship to it.
